generator_assessments.assessment: The combination of imaging studies and biopsy results confirms the presence of a vascular tumor of the thyroid with metastasis.

candidate_pool.label: Vascular Tumor of the Thyroid with Metastasis

raw_support_spans.text: Endoscopic examination found a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities.
Enhanced CT scan showed a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra
Confirmed a hypervascular tumor with anterior skull base extension (contrast enhancement after gadolinium injection, intermediate T2 signal)
Found considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions.
